t: Jupyter Notebook Workflows: From Gitstripping to Programmatic Control and Viral UX
s: This article details a robust workflow for managing Jupyter Notebooks in Git, focusing on effective metadata handling with `nbstripout` and programmatic cell extraction using `nbformat` and cell tags. It introduces the 'Dayton Wind Tunnel Moment' as a metaphor for data-driven validation before public release.
sub: Jupyter Notebooks and Git integration using nbstripout
Programmatic cell extraction with nbformat and cell tags
The 'Dayton Wind Tunnel Moment' metaphor for scientific validation
Designing a `pip.nbup()` function for seamless notebook synchronization
